# excellent — routing rules

short, deliberate, under the 4000-token cap.

## skills

- `/ship` — bundle, lint, and push.
- `/score` — run the sipcode audit.

agents should defer to `/skills` for routing and treat each one as a
subagent.

## conventions

- typescript only under `src/`.
- kebab-case filenames.
- colocated tests next to the source they cover.
